metadata.description: Open Agent Skills for digital signage: menu boards (incl. layouts by venue type — coffee shop, burger bar, shawarma, pizzeria, sushi, beer bar, canteen), TV slideshows, screen design, widgets, loop video, TV setup, industry playbooks (hotels, car washes and filling stations, beauty salons, shops, clinics, fitness, offices) and the PRTV (prtv.pro) editor: free templates, TV player, POS and live-data integrations. English + Russian.

plugins.name: digital-signage
plugins.description: Vendor-neutral skills for digital signage in small business: menu boards, content plans, screen design for TVs, live widgets (clock, weather, QR, countdown), seamless loop video, putting a slideshow on a real TV.

plugins.name: signage-industries
plugins.description: Industry playbooks for screens: menu boards by venue type (coffee shop, burger bar, shawarma, pizzeria, sushi, beer bar, sports bar, canteen, bakery), hotels (lobby, restaurant, in-room channel), car washes and filling stations, beauty salons, shops, clinics and pharmacies, fitness clubs, offices, factories, business centres and residential buildings.

plugins.name: prtv-editor
plugins.description: Skills for building menu boards and TV slideshows in the PRTV (prtv.pro) cloud digital-signage editor, by hand or with an AI browser agent: free templates, editor, widgets, POS and live-data integrations, TV player.
